Around the city. These photos set the scene; they are not of the places listed on this page.

Food in Nairobi

Visiting for a match, or just hungry this weekend? We are adding restaurants and food spots area by area. Listed so far: Kilimani, Westlands, CBD, Karen, Ngong Road, Lang'ata, Airport & Mombasa Road, Gigiri & Limuru Road and Thika Road.

Directory listing means we show only the name and location published on the business's own website. Prices and WhatsApp booking switch on when the business joins. A photo marked Example photo shows the kind of place, not the place itself.
